tool.name: Tile Images with PyHIST
tool.description: Tile pathology images using PyHIST in parallel

param.name: input_file
param.label: Input ZIP File or Single Image
param.help: Select a ZIP file containing images or a single pathology image (.svs, .tiff, .tif).

param.name: output_zip
param.label: Output ZIP Filename
param.help: Name of the output ZIP file containing tiled images (e.g., tiled_output.zip).

tool.help:
**Tile Images with PyHIST**
This tool tiles pathology images using PyHIST via Podman. It accepts either:
- A single pathology image file (e.g., .svs, .tiff, .tif). - A ZIP file containing multiple pathology images.
For ZIP files, images are processed in parallel batches (20% of total images per batch) to reduce processing time on multi-core systems. The output is a ZIP file containing tiled images organized by input image name.
**Inputs:** - **Input ZIP File or Single Image**: Upload a ZIP file or a single image file (.svs, .tiff, .tif). - **Output ZIP Filename**: Specify the name of the output ZIP file (default: tiled_output.zip).
**Outputs:** - **Tiled Images ZIP**: A ZIP file containing tiled images in folders named after each input image.
**Note**: Requires Podman and Python 3.11 on the Galaxy server. Ensure sufficient disk space and CPU cores for parallel processing.
